<thought>Based on the molecular formula C7H12N2O, DBE = 3, two carbonyl groups, and five methyl groups, a plausible structure is a dimethyl‑substituted di‑amide: CC(C)C(=O)N(C)C(=O)C. This SMILES accounts for 7 carbons, 12 hydrogens, 2 nitrogens, 1 oxygen, two carbonyls, and exactly five CH₃ groups.</thought>
